# Analysis of Bug Fix Impact: UnixFTPEntryParser Drops Leading Spaces

## Understanding the Seed Change

The bug: `UnixFTPEntryParser`'s regex consumes all whitespace between the timestamp and the filename, so `FTPFile.name` loses leading spaces. The fix adds a `trimLeadingSpaces` flag and, when set, strips leading whitespace from the parsed name:

```java
if (trimLeadingSpaces) {
    name = name.replaceFirst("^\\s+", "");
}
```

Critically, this fix **requires a new field `trimLeadingSpaces`** and **a way to set it** (constructor overload / setter), plus the regex must be adjusted so it no longer greedily eats the spaces (otherwise the flag has nothing to trim). The seed hunk alone is incomplete without these supporting changes.

---

## Assessment of the Initial Static Impact Set

### `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.UnixFTPEntryParser` (the seed class)

| Entity | Must modify? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `UnixFTPEntryParser.parseFTPEntry(java.lang.String)` | **Yes (seed)** | Directly contains the new `trimLeadingSpaces` branch. |
| `UnixFTPEntryParser.REGEX` | **Yes** | The current regex consumes all spaces between timestamp and name. For the new `replaceFirst("^\\s+","")` logic to be meaningful, the regex must be relaxed (e.g., capture the name including leading spaces, or use a non-greedy/limited whitespace match). Without changing `REGEX`, the flag is a no-op. |
| `UnixFTPEntryParser.UnixFTPEntryParser()` | **Yes** | Must initialize the new `trimLeadingSpaces` field (default value) and delegate to the new constructor. |
| `UnixFTPEntryParser.UnixFTPEntryParser(org.apache.commons.net.ftp.FTPClientConfig)` | **Yes** | Must initialize `trimLeadingSpaces` (default) and/or delegate to a new constructor accepting the flag. |

### `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.ConfigurableFTPFileEntryParserImpl`

| Entity | Must modify? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `ConfigurableFTPFileEntryParserImpl(String)` | No | Unrelated to name trimming; only sets regex. |
| `ConfigurableFTPFileEntryParserImpl(String,int)` | No | Same — regex/flags only. |
| `ConfigurableFTPFileEntryParserImpl.parseTimestamp(String)` | No | Timestamp parsing unaffected by name whitespace. |
| `ConfigurableFTPFileEntryParserImpl.timestampParser` | No | Field unrelated to name handling. |

### `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl`

| Entity | Must modify? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl(String)` | No | Generic regex setup; no name semantics. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl(String,int)` | No | Same. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl._matcher_` | No | Internal matcher state; unaffected. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl.compileRegex(String,int)` | No | Compilation logic unchanged. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl.group(int)` | No | Group accessor unchanged. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl.matches(String)` | No | Matching unchanged. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl.pattern` | No | Field unchanged. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl.result` | No | Field unchanged. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl.setRegex(String)` | No | Unchanged. |
| `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl.setRegex(String,int)` | No | Unchanged. |

### `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.FTPTimestampParser`

| Entity | Must modify? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `FTPTimestampParser.parseTimestamp(String)` | No | Interface method; timestamp parsing unrelated to filename whitespace. |

### `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.MVSFTPEntryParser`

| Entity | Must modify? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `MVSFTPEntryParser.parseUnixList(FTPFile,String)` | No | Separate parser; the bug and fix are specific to `UnixFTPEntryParser`. No shared code path is altered. |

### `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.FTPFile` (all setters/constants)

| Entity | Must modify? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `FTPFile.DIRECTORY_TYPE`, `EXECUTE_PERMISSION`, `FILE_TYPE`, `READ_PERMISSION`, `SYMBOLIC_LINK_TYPE`, `UNKNOWN_TYPE`, `WRITE_PERMISSION` | No | Constants; unaffected. |
| `FTPFile.FTPFile()` | No | Constructor unchanged. |
| `FTPFile.setGroup(String)` | No | Unrelated attribute. |
| `FTPFile.setHardLinkCount(int)` | No | Unrelated. |
| `FTPFile.setLink(String)` | No | Unrelated. |
| `FTPFile.setName(String)` | No | The fix passes the already-trimmed name into `setName`; `setName` itself needs no change. |
| `FTPFile.setPermission(int,int,boolean)` | No | Unrelated. |
| `FTPFile.setRawListing(String)` | No | Unrelated. |
| `FTPFile.setSize(long)` | No | Unrelated. |
| `FTPFile.setTimestamp(Calendar)` | No | Unrelated. |
| `FTPFile.setType(int)` | No | Unrelated. |
| `FTPFile.setUser(String)` | No | Unrelated. |

**Conclusion on the initial static impact set:** Only the four `UnixFTPEntryParser` members (the seed method, `REGEX`, and the two constructors) genuinely require modification. The rest are statically reachable but semantically unaffected by the fix.

---

## Additional Code Entities That Must Be Modified or Created (Not in Initial Set)

| Entity | Must modify/create? | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.UnixFTPEntryParser.trimLeadingSpaces` (new field) | **Create** | The seed hunk references `trimLeadingSpaces`; a boolean field must be declared to hold the flag. |
| `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.UnixFTPEntryParser.UnixFTPEntryParser(FTPClientConfig, boolean)` (new constructor) | **Create** | Callers need a way to opt into preserving leading spaces; the existing constructors must delegate to it. |
| `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.UnixFTPEntryParser.setTrimLeadingSpaces(boolean)` (new setter) | **Create (likely)** | Provides programmatic control of the flag, consistent with the configurable-parser pattern; needed so the behavior can be toggled without a new constructor. |
| `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.UnixFTPEntryParser` default regex constant (e.g., a new `DEFAULT_REGEX` / adjusted `REGEX`) | **Modify** | As noted, the regex must stop consuming the leading spaces so the trim logic can act on them; this is a prerequisite for the fix to work. |
| `org.apache.commons.net.ftp.parser.UnixFTPEntryParser` constructor(s) delegating to the new one | **Modify** | Existing constructors must set a sensible default for `trimLeadingSpaces` (typically `true` to preserve backward compatibility, or `false` to fix the bug by default — the chosen default must be consistent across constructors). |

---

## Summary

- **Must modify:** `UnixFTPEntryParser.parseFTPEntry`, `UnixFTPEntryParser.REGEX`, both existing `UnixFTPEntryParser` constructors.
- **Must create:** `trimLeadingSpaces` field, a new constructor accepting the flag, and (recommended) a setter.
- **No modification needed:** all `FTPFile` members, `ConfigurableFTPFileEntryParserImpl` members, `RegexFTPFileEntryParserImpl` members, `FTPTimestampParser.parseTimestamp`, and `MVSFTPEntryParser.parseUnixList` — they appear in the static impact set only via call/reference edges, not because the fix changes their behavior.
